description: The ulna spans the medial forearm, anchoring the elbow hinge and giving artists a reliable axis for gesture and proportion.

landmarks.name: Olecranon process
landmarks.desc: Thick posterior projection forming the elbow tip and receiving the triceps tendon.

landmarks.name: Coronoid process
landmarks.desc: Anterior beak that embraces the trochlea and supports the brachialis insertion.

landmarks.name: Trochlear notch
landmarks.desc: Semilunar articular surface that locks with the humeral trochlea for hinge motion.

landmarks.name: Radial notch
landmarks.desc: Shallow lateral facet where the radial head pivots during pronation and supination.

landmarks.name: Supinator crest
landmarks.desc: Oblique ridge distal to the radial notch that anchors the supinator muscle.

landmarks.name: Ulnar tuberosity
landmarks.desc: Rough swelling below the coronoid for the brachialis insertion and volar mass transitions.

landmarks.name: Interosseous border
landmarks.desc: Sharp lateral edge providing attachment for the interosseous membrane.

landmarks.name: Proximal anterior surface
landmarks.desc: Broad medial plane anchoring the deep finger flexors for steady drawing control.

landmarks.name: Posterior border
landmarks.desc: Long palpable ridge that shapes the medial forearm silhouette.

landmarks.name: Head of ulna
landmarks.desc: Distal swelling that articulates with the radius at the distal radioulnar joint.

landmarks.name: Styloid process
landmarks.desc: Pointed distal projection giving a crisp landmark at the medial wrist.
